fields.title: DEEPSECURE Suspicious Human Activity Recognition
fields.short_description: DeepSecure is an AI-powered video surveillance system that uses computer vision and deep learning techniques to recognize suspicious human activities from video streams and assist in identifying potentially abnormal behavior in real time.
fields.full_description:
DeepSecure – Suspicious Human Activity Recognition is a computer vision and deep learning project designed to automatically analyze human activities in video footage and identify potentially suspicious or abnormal behavior.

The system processes video frames and extracts visual and temporal patterns associated with human actions. A trained deep learning model is used to classify observed activities and distinguish potentially suspicious activities from normal human behavior.

The project aims to reduce the dependency on continuous manual monitoring by providing automated activity analysis and generating alerts when potentially suspicious behavior is detected. It demonstrates the application of artificial intelligence, computer vision, and deep learning to real-world security and surveillance scenarios.

The system can be further extended with real-time camera integration, automated alerts, activity tracking, event logging, and a web-based monitoring dashboard.
fields.problem_statement: Traditional video surveillance requires continuous human monitoring, which can be time-consuming and may result in suspicious activities being missed. An automated system is needed to analyze surveillance footage and identify potentially suspicious human activities efficiently.
fields.solution: DeepSecure uses computer vision and deep learning to process video data and recognize human activities. The system analyzes the visual information and classifies detected activities, helping provide an automated alert-oriented surveillance solution.
